subject.title: Dashboard: widget publish + community registry — the ecosystem half of the gallery

question: Should dashboard widget publishing use OpenClaw/ClawHub package provenance, a zero-infra git index convention, or remain outside bundled OpenClaw until the dashboard widget trust model is settled?
rationale: The issue defines a new distribution and untrusted-widget supply path, so automation cannot safely choose the product boundary, registry trust model, or whether raw third-party registry URLs belong in bundled OpenClaw.

options.title: ClawHub-backed widget publishing
options.body: Keep this issue open and require publish/browse/install to use package metadata, provenance, scans, explicit approvals, and dashboard-specific registry docs after the base dashboard stack lands.

options.title: Zero-infra registry with strict gates
options.body: Allow git-index registries only if maintainers define source validation, signed or pinned bundles, approval UX, update/rollback rules, and storage ownership up front.

options.title: External experiment first
options.body: Ask contributors to prove widget distribution as an external plugin or ClawHub experiment before accepting bundled dashboard registry behavior.

recommendation.title: ClawHub-backed widget publishing
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require publish/browse/install to use package metadata, provenance, scans, explicit approvals, and dashboard-specific registry docs after the base dashboard stack lands.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest current-main precedent for bundled Control UI plugin tabs and the likely product/security call for whether widget distribution becomes a bundled dashboard surface.
